title: Virtual Dispatch
hints: Put `virtual` on `Shape::area()`, `Shape::name()`, and the destructor. Then mark the derived versions `override`: the compiler will refuse to compile if a function marked `override` does not actually match a virtual in the base (a missing `const` is the classic mistake).

`virtual double area() const = 0;` makes `area` *pure virtual* and `Shape` abstract: you cannot create a bare `Shape`, only objects of derived classes that implement `area`. Keep a body on `name()` returning `"shape"` so derived classes may inherit it.
